name: Leonardo DiCaprio
role: American actor and film producer; environmental activist and UN Messenger of Peace on climate (2014)
summary: An actor whose public political activity centres almost entirely on climate change and conservation, through his foundation, documentaries and UN appearances. He has called for carbon pricing, an end to fossil fuel subsidies and large-scale government action, and has backed Democratic presidential candidates, most explicitly Kamala Harris in 2024 on climate grounds. He has said little in public about most other policy areas.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: In his 2014 UN Climate Summit address he said the crisis has grown beyond individual choices and requires decisive large-scale action by industry and governments, including carbon pricing and ending fossil fuel subsidies; in his 2016 Oscar speech he called climate change the most urgent threat facing the species; he endorsed Harris in 2024 on climate grounds.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: In 2016 he publicly backed the Standing Rock Sioux against the Dakota Access Pipeline ('Standing w/ the Great Sioux Nation to protect their water & lands'), his foundation funded Native American rights work, and his Oscar speech called for leaders who speak for indigenous peoples. This is support for indigenous land claims in specific cases rather than a stated general principle.

regulate-corporations.rationale: He called for ending the 'free ride' of industrial polluters, putting a price on carbon emissions, scrutiny of polluters and ending subsidies to oil, coal and gas companies, and criticised the rollback of environmental protections. His stated position concerns polluting industries specifically, not corporations in general.

notes: Born 11 November 1974 and living as of the audit date. His public record is narrow: almost all statements concern climate and conservation. No stated positions were found on abortion, guns, immigration, taxation or healthcare, so those are null. A 2013 donation to GLAAD was not treated as a stated position on same-sex marriage. Critics have called his private jet and yacht use inconsistent with his climate advocacy; that does not change his stated positions.
